messages:
Maya (Head of Marketing): quick flag — KPI slide shows a sudden drop in 'trial activation' after webinar cohort. planning to send the weekly update in 1h, want to confirm it's not a tracking blip.
Owen (Analytics): looking now. initial find: trial_activation event count falls at 03:20 UTC for that cohort; retention of event properties shows missing `lead_id` on ~18% of events.
Claire (Content): we updated the post-webinar thank-you flow yesterday with a new JS snippet. could that be dropping the lead_id?
Luis (Demand Gen): yes that snippet comes from the third-party scheduler. I asked them to add autofill for lead_id but maybe payload changed.
Owen (Analytics): minimal SQL I ran: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_name='trial_activation' AND cohort='webinar-apr'` vs `SELECT COUNT(distinct lead_id)`. gap = 18%.
Maya (Head of Marketing): ok hold the weekly line about post-webinar activation rate. Claire, can you pause the thank-you flow update?
Claire (Content): paused at 1761240150. rolled back to previous script.
DashBot: deploy notice: content-flow rollback succeeded at 1761240160.
Owen (Analytics): reprocessing incoming events now; I'll run a small normalization to backfill lead_id when available from the session cookie and post updated panel. ETA 20m.
Luis (Demand Gen): I'll ask scheduler ops to send a corrected payload and provide a test CSV. pinged them, ETA 2h.
Maya (Head of Marketing): great. Owen, can you add a tiny slide showing 'raw vs backfilled' numbers so comms can be transparent?
Owen (Analytics): will do — staging panel link when ready: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/panels/2104/webinar-activation-compare.png
Claire (Content): once Owen posts the chart I'll update the email copy to include a one-line note about the backfill and that normalized numbers are published.
Maya (Head of Marketing): perfect. action items: 1) Claire - paused script and update copy 2) Owen - backfill + staging panel 3) Luis - get corrected payload from scheduler. we'll reconvene if numbers don't reconcile. closing thread when weekly update goes out.
